summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly progress on its €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced on 30 April 2026. During the week of 11-15 May 2026, 1,725,000 shares were repurchased at an average price of €25.50 for a total of €43,990,442.50. Cumulative repurchases total 4,375,000 shares at an average price of €25.13 representing ~10.99% of the programme's maximum value. The programme aims to reduce share capital without stated board recommendation or advisor. Note for editors: share capital reduction under Dutch law. As a non-US issuer the Form 6-K reports a routine periodic buyback update. What to watch: pace of execution relative to announced duration and any trading windows.
